title: MeshPack Index Shard
description: Sharded file index containing a subset of file entries

entries_hash.description: Hash of the sorted entries array for integrity

creator_info.description: DEPRECATED: For backwards compatibility only. New implementations SHOULD omit this and rely on manifest.creator_info. Will be removed in format_version 2.0.0.

entries.description: Array of file entries. L2 compliance requires max 10,000 entries OR 5MB uncompressed per shard (whichever triggers first). Validators SHOULD warn if limits exceeded.

path.description: Relative path from root, POSIX separators

ids.description: Identifiers for this file in multiple namespaces (e.g., meshsync:model)

bounding_box.description: Axis-aligned bounding box in the SOURCE file's coordinate system. Use 'up_axis' to determine orientation. If 'up_axis' is +Z (common for STL), Z is vertical. If +Y (common for glTF), Y is vertical. Bounds are NOT transformed; consumers must apply up_axis conversion if needed. Units match the 'units' field.

min.description: [x, y, z] minimum corner in source coordinate system

max.description: [x, y, z] maximum corner in source coordinate system

resource_ref.description: If not null, corresponds to a file in resources/<hash>.<ext>

resource_hash.description: Hash of the embedded resource file, if included

metamodel_id.description: DEPRECATED: Single metamodel ID. Use 'metamodels' array for 1:N support. Kept for backward compatibility; if both present, 'metamodels' takes precedence.

metamodel_role.description: DEPRECATED: Use 'metamodels' array with per-assignment roles. Applies to metamodel_id if metamodels[] is absent.

metamodels.description: Array of metamodel memberships. A file can belong to multiple metamodels (e.g., shared component in multiple kits). Each entry specifies the metamodel and the role within it. Supersedes metamodel_id/metamodel_role when present.

role.description: Role within this metamodel. A file CAN be 'canonical' in multiple metamodels.

assembly.description: Assembly graph info for placing this file. Transform is 4x4 column-major matrix, right-handed +Y up coordinate system.

transform.description: 4x4 homogeneous transform matrix in column-major order (OpenGL/glTF convention)

preview_ref.description: Reference to preview thumbnail in resources/

extensions.description: Extension data. Reserved keys starting with '_' are spec-defined.

_deleted.description: Delta pack marker: if true, this entry was DELETED from the base pack. When present, size_bytes MUST be 0 and hash MUST be all zeros.
